registration_timing: Registered after the fixed 20-replicate screening study (replicates 221 through 240) was completed, independently reconstructed in R 4.5.1, and reported, but before generation or fitting of confirmatory replicates 241 through 340.

screening_source.role: Endpoint and direction selection only; screening observations are not pooled into confirmation.

purpose: Confirm or refute the candidate sensitivity of normal-person marginal likelihood Rater recovery to latent ability-by-rater-severity assignment dependence, while holding observation density, Rater exposure, generated responses, category support, and structural connectivity fixed.

data_generating_process.person_distribution: normal standardized within replicate to realized mean 0 and population SD 0.8
data_generating_process.common_random_numbers: The two observation designs are subsets of the same newly generated complete response matrix within replicate. Assignment masks use Theta and identifiers but never realized scores.

planned_connected.rule: Person-index adjacent Rater ring independent of generated Theta.

ability_severity_aligned_connected.ability_quartile_rule: Stable sort by generated Theta, tie-break by Person identifier, exactly 20 Persons per quartile.
ability_severity_aligned_connected.role: latent ability-dependent assignment stressor; not an identified real-data missingness model

estimation_layers.role: external same-estimand calibration and descriptive design-sensitivity context

estimation_layers.estimand: normal-person marginal likelihood with SD fixed at 0.8
normal-person marginal likelihood with SD estimated

primary_endpoint.statistic_per_replicate: Rater RMSE in ability_severity_aligned_connected minus Rater RMSE in planned_connected, each RMSE over aligned truth errors for R01 through R04.
primary_endpoint.test: one-sample one-sided Student t test over 100 paired replicate contrasts
primary_endpoint.replication_decision: All 100 registered contrasts finite, mean contrast greater than zero, and one-sided p <= 0.05.

secondary_family.multiplicity: Four pre-specified one-sided paired endpoints controlled by Holm's step-down procedure at family-wise alpha 0.05. Secondary results are interpreted only after the primary endpoint replicates.

endpoints.statistic: PYTHON_MML_FIXED_SD08_Q31 Rater RMSE aligned minus planned
PYTHON_MML_FREE_SD_Q31 estimated population SD aligned minus planned
Within replicate OLS slope of the four Rater level truth-error contrasts (aligned minus planned) on true severities [-0.45, -0.15, 0.15, 0.45] for PYTHON_MML_FREE_SD_Q31
Within replicate OLS slope of the four Rater level truth-error contrasts (aligned minus planned) on true severities [-0.45, -0.15, 0.15, 0.45] for PYTHON_MML_FIXED_SD08_Q31

secondary_family.test: one-sample one-sided Student t test over 100 paired replicate statistics
secondary_family.intervals: two-sided 95% Student t intervals reported for magnitude; Holm adjustment applies to the four one-sided p values

descriptive_context_only: JMLE and exact-CMLE Rater RMSE/MAE design contrasts
Task, Criterion, and PCM-threshold RMSE/MAE design contrasts for every estimator
Rater level truth-error contrasts for JMLE and exact CMLE

method_comparison_contract.facets_role: JMLE external calibration only; FACETS is not a gold standard for MML or CMLE estimands.

precision_contract.scientific_statistics: Use native-precision Python estimates and truth errors.
precision_contract.facets_display: Use registered Umean=6 measures for direct recovery calibration and separately parsed Table 8 fields where applicable.
precision_contract.rounding_prohibition: Do not reconstruct fit, residual, recovery, or inferential statistics from FACETS' usual two-decimal display.

operational_contract.facets_retry: At most two retries only for exit-0/missing named report.
operational_contract.facets_serialization: Shared cross-process lock and short retained work roots.

analysis_order: Complete all 800 registered attempt units without scientific interim summaries.
Verify completion markers, registered denominators, design invariants, constraints, and same-estimand FACETS/Python calibration.
Reconstruct the primary endpoint independently in R 4.5.1 before interpreting it.
Evaluate IA1 and its Monte Carlo precision qualification.
If IA1 replicates, evaluate IA2 through IA5 with Holm family-wise control.
Report all descriptive context without converting non-signals into invariance claims or estimator rankings.
stop_rules: Stop before fitting if row counts, Rater exposure, connectivity, constrained PCM nullity, quartile sizes, shared-response hashes, or fresh replicate range fail.
Retain and report every estimator and FACETS failure in the planned denominator.
Do not impute, replace, or silently rerun a completed statistical attempt.
Do not inspect endpoint summaries until all planned attempts complete and the aggregate qualification gates pass.
Do not interpret FACETS Subset connection O.K. as a substitute for the independent constrained-design rank audit.
Do not modify endpoints, directions, alpha, or precision thresholds based on confirmatory results.
claim_limit: This confirmation can test reproducibility under one deliberately constructed latent ability-by-severity assignment mechanism and one correctly specified PCM configuration. It cannot identify an empirical missingness mechanism, validate a MAR/MNAR correction, prove universal estimator robustness, or establish an estimator ranking.
